candidates.source_name: Telegrafi — Ekonomi / tag feeds (Banka Qendrore e Kosovës, Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës)
candidates.why_relevant: Highest-traffic Albanian-language Kosovo news portal; publishes bank press releases, signing ceremonies (nënshkruhet marrëveshja/kontrata), digitalisation announcements and CBK/BQK news near-verbatim and fast. Entity tag pages act as ready-made per-actor feeds (e.g. /tag/banka-qendrore-e-kosoves/, /tag/shoqata-e-bankave-te-kosoves/), which makes it a low-cost weak-signal tripwire for private-bank IT and payments contracts that never reach a public register.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted editorial content; metadata/headline harvesting for internal intelligence generally acceptable, no republication
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll category and entity tag pages on a schedule; keyword-filter titles on sq trigger terms (nënshkru*, kontratë, tender, bankomat, POS, kartela, sistem pagesash); store URL+date+snippet only
candidates.discovered_via_method: sq keyword search + snowball from tag pages surfaced in results

negative_findings.description: Targeted sq/mixed query for recent news on ATM and POS terminal supply contracts in Kosovo ('POS terminale' OR 'bankomatë' Kosovë kompani furnizim lajm 2025) returned only bank product/marketing pages and regional Serbian bank POS pages — no news articles naming a supplier or a contract.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero media hits; results dominated by raiffeisen-kosovo.com, nlb-kos.com, teb-kos.com product pages and Serbian banks' POS pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell premise inversely: supplier-side terminal contracts in Kosovo are largely invisible to general web search and will need site-scoped searching within each sq outlet plus bank corporate-news pages, not open-web queries.

negative_findings.description: The seed query 'nënshkruhet kontrata bankë Kosovë sistem pagesash' returned regulatory PDFs from BQK rather than any media report of a contract signing.
negative_findings.result_summary: All top results were BQK regulations on interbank payments and electronic payment instruments; no news item.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'sistem pagesash' is regulator-owned vocabulary and pulls legal texts. Media-facing queries need contract-ceremony vocabulary instead (nënshkruhet marrëveshja, memorandum bashkëpunimi, partneritet, lansohet) plus an outlet-scoped site: filter.

negative_findings.description: Preportr (COHU investigative journalism centre) did not appear in any result set this run despite being queried by name alongside Kallxo.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate at reduced confidence with no example URLs; its domain is asserted from prior knowledge, not from an observed link.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A named, on-topic procurement watchdog is missing from the evidence base; if the domain has moved, the highest-value long-form procurement source for Kosovo would be silently absent from the collection plan.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed endpoints were confirmed for any of the sq outlets in this cell; no feed URL was observed in search results and no page was fetched to check for feed autodiscovery.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection methods above therefore assume HTML listing-page polling.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Feed availability materially changes collection cost and latency for a weak-signal channel that depends on being early. This needs a per-domain probe pass before the collector is built.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is scoped to Albanian-language media only. Serbian-language Kosovo outlets (northern-municipality and Serb-community media) were deliberately not searched, so any bank/payments signal that appears only in sr within Kosovo is uncovered by this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a companion cell for sr-language Kosovo media (e.g. KoSSev, Kontakt Plus, Radio Gorazdevac and Belgrade outlets covering Kosovo) using sr terms: potpisan ugovor, tender, bankomat, POS terminali, platni sistem.

coverage_gaps.description: Trade/vendor-side media were not covered: regional IT and fintech trade press, vendor press-release wires, and LinkedIn/company newsrooms of payments suppliers active in Kosovo. These often announce a win before any Kosovo outlet reports it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a cell for vendor and regional trade press plus supplier newsroom monitoring (card personalisation, ATM/POS vendors, core-banking integrators operating in the Western Balkans).

coverage_gaps.description: No archival or historical-search capability was established for these sq outlets. Kosovo news portals restructure and quietly unpublish; several older links surfaced in this run were from paths that may not persist.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair each monitored outlet with a Wayback Machine snapshot check and archive every captured item's URL at collection time.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal-level sq media (Prizren, Gjakovë, Ferizaj, Mitrovicë local portals and radio) were not enumerated. Municipal contracting authorities are a large share of Kosovo procurement volume and their awards are often reported only locally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the local-outlet link list from the sq aggregator (shkabaj.net) and triage municipal portals for a follow-on cell.

coverage_gaps.description: All searching this run was open-web. No site-scoped searching (site:telegrafi.com kontratë bankë, site:kallxo.com bankomat) was performed, which is the technique most likely to actually surface the low-frequency contract items this cell targets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run this cell with per-domain site: queries against the ~10 confirmed sq outlets using the full sq glossary, and look past the first page of results.

brief: Albanian-language Kosovo media form a usable but shallow weak-signal layer: a small set of national outlets (Telegrafi, Koha, KosovaPress, Klan Kosova, IndeksOnline, Bota Sot) reprint bank and regulator announcements quickly and with low editorial filtering, while a much smaller investigative tier (KALLXO/BIRN, Preportr/COHU) does the only genuine procurement reporting, naming contracting authority, winner and value. Two sq-language economy specialists (Ekonomia Online, Ekonomia-ks) and commercial tender aggregators (Utender.eu, Tenderi-Kos) sit alongside as corroboration layers, with bank 'Shpallje' pages and the BQK tenders page as the ground truth these media items must resolve to. Open-web queries in sq proved weak for the specific target — ATM/POS supply contracts produced no media hits at all, and the regulator's own vocabulary ('sistem pagesash') pulls legal texts rather than news — so the practical collection design is per-domain site-scoped search plus scheduled listing-page polling with an sq contract-ceremony glossary. The principal gaps are the untouched Serbian-language Kosovo media, vendor-side trade press, and municipal local outlets.
